topic: How can satellite link budgets be optimized for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage?
consensus_response: Satellite link budgets can be optimized by employing adaptive modulation, beamforming, and strategic buffer management. Forward Error Correction (FEC) and interleaving techniques mitigate error bursts, while diversity methods enhance signal robustness. These approaches collectively reduce latency and improve throughput in high-latency satellite links.
reference_context: High latency in satellite communications is due to signal propagation time, affecting real-time applications and requiring adaptations in protocol state machines and congestion control mechanisms.
